# C12 Catalogue and ISO data browser

Group: Authoring UI. Phase: 2, 3. Stories: 4. Size: 18 SP.

## Purpose

Let the designer find any artefact and any canonical element, and see who uses it.

## Read first

- `design/10-studio-functions.md`
- `design/02-canonical-context.md`
- `design/01-concepts-scopes-names-versions.md`
- every schema under `schemas/`
- `CLAUDE.md`, for the guard-rails and the common Definition of Done

## Depends on

- C01 Artefact store and naming
- C03 Canonical model and type generation
- C04 Static checks
- C06 Rule service
- C17 Tenants, roles and maker-checker

## Success for the component

Functions F-01 to F-05 pass their acceptance lines against the factory pack.

## Stories

### C12-S1 Catalogue browse and search

Size: 5 SP. Phase 2. Branch: `story/c12-s1-catalogue-browse-and-search`.

**Story.** As a designer, I want to browse and search artefacts by scope, kind, type and text, so that I reuse a block before I build one.

**Definition of Ready**

- Read: `design/10-studio-functions.md`, `design/02-canonical-context.md`, `design/01-concepts-scopes-names-versions.md`; every schema under `schemas/`.
- Done first: nothing in this backlog.
- Fixtures: `factory/`, `examples/`.

**Definition of Done**

- Filters for scope, kind, activity type, status and major line; free text over name, title and context paths.
- A tenant sees shared content and its own, and nothing of another tenant.
- The common Definition of Done in `CLAUDE.md` holds.

**Definition of Success**

- uae.p.validate.iban.v1 is found by its name, by its title and by the path payment.creditorAccount.

### C12-S2 Artefact page

Size: 3 SP. Phase 2. Branch: `story/c12-s2-artefact-page`.

**Story.** As a designer, I want one page per artefact with its contract, releases, tests and users, so that I can judge a block without opening its file.

**Definition of Ready**

- Read: `design/10-studio-functions.md`, `design/02-canonical-context.md`, `design/01-concepts-scopes-names-versions.md`; every schema under `schemas/`.
- Done first: `C12-S1`.
- Fixtures: `factory/`, `examples/`.

**Definition of Done**

- The page shows the contract, every release with its hash, the tests and their last result, and every artefact that references it.
- The common Definition of Done in `CLAUDE.md` holds.

**Definition of Success**

- The users list of p.reserve.funds.v1 equals the reference graph that L03 builds.

### C12-S3 ISO data browser

Size: 5 SP. Phase 3. Branch: `story/c12-s3-iso-data-browser`.

**Story.** As a designer, I want to search any canonical element, type or code and see which blocks read and write it, so that I see the full ISO data capability.

**Definition of Ready**

- Read: `design/10-studio-functions.md`, `design/02-canonical-context.md`, `design/01-concepts-scopes-names-versions.md`; every schema under `schemas/`.
- Done first: `C12-S1`, `C03-S1`.
- Fixtures: `factory/`, `examples/`.

**Definition of Done**

- Search by element name, ISO type and code value; each element shows readers, writers and whether it is personal data.
- Extensions are shown under their scope and are told apart from ISO elements.
- The common Definition of Done in `CLAUDE.md` holds.

**Definition of Success**

- Every reader and writer of payment.instructedAmount in the factory pack is listed, and none is missed.

### C12-S4 Scheme message catalogue and samples

Size: 5 SP. Phase 3. Branch: `story/c12-s4-scheme-message-catalogue-and-samples`.

**Story.** As a scheme owner, I want the message catalogue of a scheme with dispositions and sample messages, so that coverage is visible and tests have inputs.

**Definition of Ready**

- Read: `design/10-studio-functions.md`, `design/02-canonical-context.md`, `design/01-concepts-scopes-names-versions.md`; every schema under `schemas/`.
- Done first: `C12-S3`, `C06-S2`.
- Fixtures: `factory/`, `examples/`.

**Definition of Done**

- The dispatch table is shown per scheme with planned entries marked.
- A valid and an invalid sample are generated per message; each is labelled with the rule it breaks.
- The common Definition of Done in `CLAUDE.md` holds.

**Definition of Success**

- The valid salary file sample passes uae.wps.ruleset.salary-file.v1 and the invalid one fails with the code it is labelled with.
